Small fix for Minecraft 1.21.6 to 26.3 (Fabric, on Linux, Windows and macOS).

Pick the file that matches your game, same as 0.7.0. If automatic updates are on, SkyLyrics fetches it for you.

### Fixed
- **Open Music tab** in the song library now scrolls straight down to the Spotify card, so you land where you sign in. Before, it could drop you back at the top of the Music tab, which looked like nothing happened.
